title: Standardize engineering artifacts across agents

summary.answer: Make Semantic contract the one enforcement point. Ship behind a switch, then delete the old path.
summary.context: Today skills/agent-artifacts/ and src/agent_artifacts/schemas/ each decide which sections an artifact must carry on their own.
summary.what_changes_it: Scenario regression lacks a required semantic section or fails visual review.

objective: Agents write evidence-backed semantic contracts and one engine renders predictable HTML and durable Markdown.
current_state: Plans, ADRs, reviews, and handoffs change structure and visual emphasis from one model session to the next.
approach: Route one slice through Semantic contract. Delete the old path once parity holds.
